app.title: Healthy Route
app.tagline: Healthier walking and cycling routes in Kraków

route.clickHint: Type an address or click the map: the first click sets the start, the second the destination.

metrics.sameAsFastest: The fastest route is also the healthiest here: no detour needed.

warnings.partial_coverage: Part of the route lies outside the city data (outside Kraków); a neutral value was used there.
warnings.air_unavailable: No current air data: the air term does not affect the route right now.
warnings.smog_hint: Elevated PM10: consider the “Clean air” profile.

errors.outside_city: The app covers Kraków only. Pick a point inside the city.
errors.far_from_network: The point is too far from a street or path. Pick a place closer to a street.
errors.same_point: Start and destination are the same place.
errors.no_route: No route found between these points.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

air.title: Air in Kraków
air.indicative: Indicative: the mean of GIOŚ stations, spread in space by proximity to traffic. Not a street-level measurement.
air.source: Source: GIOŚ, Air Quality Portal. Data are not continuously verified.

legend.traffic: far → close to a busy road

planner.intro: Street segments where high exposure (noise, traffic, little greenery) meets many sensitive users: schools, kindergartens, nurseries and residents.
planner.who: within 200 m: {{schools}} schools ({{pupils}} pupils), {{kg}} kindergartens, {{nur}} nurseries
planner.method: Method: priority = exposure × presence of sensitive people, in 150 m cells. Weights in config/etl.yml.

about.title: Data sources
about.disclaimer: The exposure index compares routes with each other. It is not a medical assessment. The noise map is a 2022 strategic model, the greenery map is from 2016, and the air term is indicative.
about.privacy: Privacy: route requests are processed and discarded. No locations are stored and no analytics cookies are used.
about.inspiration: Method inspired by Green Paths 2 (DigitalGeographyLab, MIT licence).
